summary: Visual redesign regression pass complete. Neo-Brutalist tactile UI (orange #FF4500, hard black borders, offset drop shadows, Outfit/Plus Jakarta Sans/JetBrains Mono fonts) has been successfully applied across all screens. Backend /api/health returns 200 and /api/ai-explanation returns valid AI-generated markdown responses. Frontend loads correctly, custom Google Fonts (Outfit_700Bold, Outfit_600SemiBold, PlusJakartaSans_400Regular, PlusJakartaSans_700Bold) are properly loaded via useFonts (verified via computed style inspection - NOT falling back to system fonts). Onboarding flow, Home, Practice sessions, Practice category grid, Progress, Profile, and Paywall all render with the new tactile design. All previously fixed functionality (adaptive practice loading real questions, option selection with green/red feedback, official/AI explanation display, paywall purchase unlocking premium locally on web, tab navigation, testIDs) remains intact. No layout overflows, broken images, or unreadable text detected on desktop viewport. Pexels hero images (scenic road, steering wheel) load correctly with gradient overlays.
critical_code_review_comments: Redesign is well-executed - hard black borders, orange pill buttons, tactile shadows, and monospace numeric display are consistent across screens.
Fonts are loaded correctly via useFonts before rendering (ActivityIndicator gates render), preventing FOUT.
Hero images use expo-image with gradient overlays and render correctly on web via react-native-web.
